newsitem.title: USA: Witnesses testify in McVeigh trial penalty phase.
newsitem.headline: Witnesses testify in McVeigh trial penalty phase.

text.p: Prosecutors Friday presented the last of their witnesses to testify in the penalty phase in the trial of convicted Oklahoma City bomber Timothy McVeigh.

Among the witnesses to testify in the morning court session was Oklahoma City Police Officer Don Browning, a former Marine and Vietnam veteran who described his recurring nightmare since the April 19, 1995 bombing of the Alfred P. Murrah federal building.
In his bad dream, he said, he is crawling into the rubble of the building.
"I begin to feel the ground tremble beneath me. It turns into a growl, a monstrous growl. I turn and run. The kids are crying. I feel so very guilty I didn't get to them," he said.
The jurors also saw a videotape of Nikia McCloud, who was 4 years old at the time of the explosion. It left her with severe permanent brain damage.
The seven men and five women found McVeigh guilty Monday of 11 federal charges, including conspiracy and murder. They now will decide whether he is executed or spends his life in prison.
